svg.desc: A static phone illustration. A tenant asks for a 2 BHK in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, under 45,000 rupees per month near the metro. A sample property reply shows an illustrative home at 43,000 rupees per month. The reply includes an illustrative Contact owner action. This is not a live listing or chat. The contact action, icons and composer are decorative.
